pageCache.text:
A World-Class Preparatory in Marylebone, Central London
Wetherby Prep School
Wetherby Prep Becomes Co-Educational
Now welcoming girls and boys
Wetherby Prep’s transition to co-education marks a thoughtful evolution in our story, one that enriches learning, strengthens pathways, and provides even more opportunities for every child.
Learn more Register Your Interest
Setting the Standard for Exceptional Prep Education in London
Welcome to Wetherby Prep, a prestigious and well-established private boys’ preparatory in Marylebone, Central London. As one of London’s top prep schools, Wetherby Prep has developed an unparalleled record of exceptional academic provision and inspiring opportunities that successfully prepare boys for a lifetime of accomplishment.
At our leading prep school in London, we prepare pupils to excel in their 11+ and 13+ Common Entrance examinations. Best-in-class academic provision and bespoke, holistic preparation mean that boys secure coveted places at some of the best senior schools in London, often on merit-based scholarships.
A Holistic, Innovative Prep Programme in London
Our curriculum is carefully crafted to develop all aspects of our boys’ potential, in the classroom, onstage and on the sports field. Through an extensive, expert-led extracurricular programme, pupils develop their unique talents in exciting disciplines and foster the tools for success in prep school and beyond.
Wetherby Prep equips pupils with a solid educational foundation that includes top academic preparation, diverse and in-demand skills, strong values and an appreciation for positive interpersonal relationships and community.
Why Choose Our Prep School in Marylebone, London?
Our leading preparatory in London, ranked ‘excellent’ by the Independent Schools Inspectorate, offers a challenging, nurturing environment in which each and every pupil sets high standards and gains valuable skills to achieve his greatest ambitions.
Our curriculum is carefully crafted to deliver leading preparation for the Common Entrance exams and Scholarships, with outstanding results. After graduating from Wetherby Prep, pupil attend some of the most prestigious senior schools in the UK, including Eton, Harrow and Winchester College.
Extensive extracurriculars allow boys to develop their unique passions, explore new disciplines, and become confident, independent, multi-skilled pupils. Experts in sports and arts prepare boys for exceptional achievements, whether in national sporting events or performances at top London venues.
A Meticulously Planned, Ambitious Curriculum
Balancing academic rigour and holistic development with outstanding, tailored support and preparation for the 11+ and 13+ Common Entrance exams.
Admission to Top UK Senior Schools
Our graduates secure entry into prestigious senior schools, including Eton College and St Paul's, with many gaining merit-based scholarships.
Extensive & Premium Extracurriculars
Maximising boys’ unique potential in sports, the arts and many other exciting disciplines.
A Path to Success Beyond Prep School
A values-based prep education for boys in an ideal setting, fostering their unique talents with exceptional opportunities.
Reception
Lower School
Upper School
Outstanding results in the 11+ and 13+ Common Entrance exams and top senior school destinations point to our prowess at providing the best possible outcomes for our boys. Graduates of Wetherby Prep secured places at some of the UK’s best day and boarding schools over the past 5 years, including:
Wetherby Prep is part of Inspired Education, a group of 121 prestigious private schools worldwide. As an Inspired school, we strive to maximise our students’ potential with an outstanding prep education and unique, enriching opportunities, from leading tutelage and academic preparation to exciting extracurricular activities which foster exceptional sporting and artistic abilities. The Group’s unparalleled offering is based on a commitment to excellence that spans Academics, Sport and the Performing and Creative Arts. As a result, graduates of Inspired schools are academically accomplished, confident, independent and multi-skilled individuals.
Part of a Global Group of Top Independent Schools
Part of a Global Group of Top Independent Schools
With 85,000+ students across 6 continents, Inspired schools set the standard for exemplary private education globally. Each school is carefully crafted to promote top outcomes using innovative methods and a shared holistic approach, yet also remains anchored in its local context and community. This provides pupils with a solid educational foundation for their future and allows graduates to flourish at the highest levels, no matter where in the world they end up.
Hand-Picked Teachers
Hand-Picked Teachers
Teachers at Inspired schools are hand-selected for their outstanding credentials and experience. Their genuine passion is reflected in their lessons, in which innovative methods meet global best practices to produce stimulating and inspiring interventions, including in highly respected international curricula. With impeccable prep tutelage, our pupils score highly on assessments and enjoy a seamless transition into the next stage of their education.
Guaranteed Entry to Premium Boarding Schools
Guaranteed Entry to Premium Boarding Schools
Upon graduating from our independent prep school, pupils may choose to expand their horizons by enrolling in any of Inspired’s boarding schools globally. Inspired students gain automatic entry into exceptional private secondary schools across Spain, Kenya, the United Kingdom and elsewhere, where they continue to enjoy excellent opportunities in academics, sports, the arts, and other areas.
Exchange Programmes & Global Camps
Exchange Programmes & Global Camps
As part of a global community of Inspired schools, our pupils access a range of exciting travel opportunities. Student exchange programmes and global summer camps offer valuable experience by allowing the pupils to immerse themselves in other cultures. As a result, our boys gain skills and qualities that allow them to flourish well beyond the prep school level while developing lifelong friendships and connections.
Discover how our preparatory for boys in London can help maximise your son's potential in class and out and establish a path to unlimited future opportunities.

About Us
A Word From the Headmaster
At the end of his life, Isaac Newton compared himself to a boy on the beach playing in the sand, unaware of the vast ocean of truth that lay everywhere around him.
Education is about discovering truth. In the early years the truth about yourself and those immediately around you, and as time goes by the truth about the world and about the things that other people hold true.
We aim to help and guide the children at Wetherby. Help them find the truth about themselves; guide them to discover the values and qualities in others.
Every child, every single child, has the capacity to excel. But at what? At what stage? And in what way?
Our skill comes from knowing how to identify your child's passions. How to motivate and inspire, when to be firm and when to let things coast along. Many schools push hard for academic achievement, but cramming is not a solution, just a way of storing up disappointment. We believe education must be fostered from within - it stems from connecting not directing.
We work hard to ensure that Wetherby pupils receive a balanced, all-round education. They will leave us at the peak of their abilities and will have attained their potential in their own right, at the right pace and in their own time. They will be well-balanced, well-attuned, well in mind and body.
They will succeed because they have learned how to succeed. Happy in themselves, happy in each other's company, confident in their abilities, sure about the future, ready to build on the qualities they have developed in their time with us, ready to use those qualities to make things better for themselves and better for the world around them.
In London, where parents are spoiled for choice when choosing a Prep School, Wetherby offers that little bit extra, backed by the Inspired Group who believe passionately in education and offer support and excellence to us as a school.
Pupils leave us ready to move onto their Senior Schools in London and beyond, and we are proud to send our children to the top day and boarding schools across the country.
Come and see for yourself what a truly exciting and dynamic school this is. I shall be delighted to meet you and to introduce you to our wonderful Wetherby Ambassadors.
With warmest wishes,
A Heritage of Educational Excellence
As a Wetherby school, we are part of a long and established tradition of excellence in private education. By developing and nurturing our students to unlock their full potential, both in class and out, we prepare them for unlimited success in the next stage of their educational journey.
Our well-known record for outstanding education is due to a meticulously planned, holistic approach that combines academic rigour with an enriching co-curricular programme to maximise children’s development across areas. The curriculum is ambitious and carefully designed, with best-in-class preparation for the Common Entrance Examinations, led by passionate teachers with impeccable credentials and with regular school trips to enhance the subject matter. An extensive sports programme allows students to develop their physical skills and become locally, nationally and globally accomplished in rugby, football, golf and other sports, while an exciting and broad club offering helps them nurture their unique talents and abilities.
A Pathway to Success
Students at Wetherby benefit from a holistic, child-centred approach, which aims to develop their intellectual, physical, social and moral selves. Our success can be seen in the broad selection of prestigious senior schools that they enter and the successful, balanced, accomplished lives they lead as adults. The following statements are a summary of our aims and underscore our commitment to all-round excellence:
Effective Pastoral Care
Effective and consistent pastoral care contributes to a happy environment in which students flourish. To achieve this at Wetherby, we offer:
An Ambitious, Tailored Curriculum
An appropriate academic curriculum helps to raise Wetherby boys’ aspirations. The following are key to achieving this:
Generous Extracurricular Offering
An extensive range of clubs, sporting activities and school trips motivate students to develop their sporting, social and leisure interests, together with attitudes that will hold them in good stead for adult life. The following attributes are promoted at Wetherby:
Guidance on appropriate choices of senior schools.
Our Values
Our School Values were chosen by the School Council Representatives, staff and the pupils themselves, ensuring they truly reflect what is important to us. Each value is deeply connected with the others and, as such, they are recognised collectively as an ‘outlook’ (as described by a boy during one School Council meeting) rather than individual traits.
The journey at our school is a marathon, not a sprint. Our learners receive plenty of support and encouragement to keep trying their very best, especially in things they find difficult at first. We challenge them to have high expectations of themselves, as staff do, and persist in striving for their goals, no matter what they are. We want learners to be confident, with a strong sense of self-belief.
Respect is knowing that others are valuable, be it those in our school community or the wider world. We take care of our environments and the things in them, understanding that rules are there for a reason. We expect politeness, tolerance and understanding from all in our school. Our boys also respect themselves, realising their value as part of our community.
We feel strongly that honesty drives academic achievement and teaches students to advocate for themselves, and we want to prepare learners to participate in shaping their own lives, communities and the future. Relationships are at the heart of our school, and being honest can only strengthen these relationships, foster empathy, and help our community to be even stronger.
At our school, we teach in a way that respects the diversity of our boys. We welcome all through our doors and want to make sure that everyone is happy being who they are, feels confident and, in turn, reaches their full potential. Our world is a beautifully diverse place, and we hope Wetherby is the first stepping stone in boys’ realisation that unique contributions lead to the very best results.
Some of the most important milestones in a person’s life are reached after working in a team. Teamwork allows each student to feel heard and valued and ensures that he realises the importance of valuing others. It provides a chance for every boy to offer his perspective and use his talents to contribute to the task at hand. We have seen how working as a team significantly boosts our boys’ self-esteem and allows them to come together as a community.
Kindness is a constant throughout school life, seen daily in lessons, activities and social situations. Although the word ‘kindness’ is learned at a young age, it is equally relevant when one is an adult. It is a selfless act for which nothing is expected in return. Kindness toward others and ourselves has huge benefits, both physical and mental, and we encourage the boys to be kind in every situation.
Our History
The success of Wetherby Pre-Prep School (established in 1951) and parents’ desire for a prep school option with Wetherby's unique ethos led to the opening of Wetherby Prep in 2004, with 24 boys in Year 4. Since then, we have grown organically, and we currently have 350+ students across Years 3 to 8.
Upon relocating to our new and larger premises in Bryanston Square, we continued to grow, develop and provide first-class education to our students.
Wetherby Prep acquired a new sports facility in East Acton, affording additional room for much-needed outdoor activities.
Wetherby Senior School opened in Marylebone, broadening our list of exceptional school destinations.
The Wetherby family expanded with the opening of Wetherby School Kensington.
Our school became part of Inspired Education, the leading global group of independent schools, opening pupils to exceptional opportunities to succeed both in class and beyond.
Learn how your child can benefit from an outstanding holistic education at our school, where we will challenge and support them on their path to unlimited accomplishments.

Our Curriculum
A Supportive and Challenging Path to Exemplary Academic Success
Our ambitious curriculum is carefully crafted to unlock each child's potential and provide a solid foundation for future academic achievement.
In the Lower School, emphasis is placed on providing a smooth transition from the pre-prep years, while supporting and fostering our students' development. Children grow gradually more confident and independent, nurturing critical skills and personal qualities as they navigate our broad and aspirational syllabus.
Upper School is a time of academic rigour when pupils develop a deeper understanding across subjects, culminating in outstanding results in the Common Entrance examinations. Students take on more responsibility and become role models for the lower years while championing our values and ethos. As a result, they leave fully equipped for life in senior school and beyond.
Pre Prep
Wetherby Prep School is excited to announce the launch of a new Reception class from September 2026. This addition complements the established early years provision already offered at Wetherby School Notting Hill and Wetherby Kensington. Our vision is to extend the success of our highly regarded pre-preparatory schools, which are renowned for delivering outstanding early childhood education for boys aged 4 to 8.
Every boy will be supported in discovering his individual talents, strengths, and passions, and encouraged to strive for excellence in all aspects of school life. Through a carefully designed, challenging, and inspiring curriculum, enriched by exceptional extracurricular opportunities, enrichment programmes, and dedicated pastoral care, each boy will be guided towards achieving his very best.
Lower School
Lower School consists of Years 3, 4 and 5. Year 3 very much mirrors the nurturing experience of pre-prep in that lessons are delivered by one holistic subject teacher and subject specialists. In Year 4, the boys begin to move from class to class for different subjects, reflecting their progress toward Upper School and greater independence. By Year 5, they are fully immersed in Wetherby Prep life and readying themselves for the rigours of Upper School. Whether in the classroom, on the sports fields or on excursions, students forge and strengthen their relationships with peers and staff members, grow evermore independent and build confidence in themselves academically, socially and emotionally.
Lower School Curriculum
Upper School
In Upper School (Years 6-8), pupils work hard to prepare for the Common Entrance and Scholarship exams. Once their exams are completed, an extensive post-Common Entrance programme helps pupils look forward and prepare for life beyond prep school.
Students constantly seek to try new things, and with a club to suit every interest, Wetherby Prep lets them do so. Boys may join invitation-only clubs (e.g., Advanced Drama) and showcase their talents and abilities (e.g., during Creative Arts Evenings).
Our Upper School is busy and bursting with opportunity, and pupils leave Wetherby as well-rounded, driven individuals ready to take on their next chapter.
Upper School Curriculum
Subjects
Every subject is integral to our syllabus and contributes to a strong, all-rounded education. Our talented teachers bring a wealth of knowledge and outstanding credentials, which ensure that their lessons are always stimulating, interesting and inspirational, and ultimately prepare pupils to excel in senior school.
The subjects we offer are listed below. Please click on a subject for more details.
Art & Design Technology
In the Art and Design Departments, we develop individual creativity through our wealth of resources and expertise. We provide tuition in a wide range of media: painting, 3D design, woodwork, clay and wire modelling, screen printing, pastel work, ink studies, and lino reduction and 3D printing. Artwork is placed into context, Old Masters are taught alongside modern artists. Art Theory is explored and we delve into the artists’ motivations behind the works that we study.
Classwork is enhanced by external workshops and exhibitions in a wide array of London-based galleries (e.g., the National Gallery, British Museum and V&A Museum). Professional artists (e.g., Tracey Emin, CBE, RA) regularly visit our Art Room, offering valuable insight into the life of an artist and contemporary practice. Our Advanced Artists Programme further develops our learners’ potential by helping them build a portfolio for senior school art scholarships, which many have been awarded.
Projects are designed to encompass a range of concepts and themes and be integrated into other subjects too.
The Art Department runs daily after-school clubs in Drawing, Arts and Crafts, Design Engineering and other areas, and creative holiday clubs ranging from Design and Engineering to Painting, Drawing and Clay workshops. The annual Art Exhibition for Lower and Upper School showcases all of the work generated over the year with professional displays at various social events and exhibition evenings.
We encourage peer work and support each other’s growth as artists and the development of our ideas. A studio-style environment allows students to explore their personal creative journeys and collaborative practice, building empathy and fostering problem-solving skills.
The Art and Design offer extends to staff and parents, making Wetherby Prep a hive of activity and a truly creative community.
The Classics Department is responsible for teaching Latin, Greek and Classical Civilisation, encompassing not only the language but also cultural, historical and mythological elements of the ancient world. The breadth of this study offers boys an insight not only into ancient cultures but also into their own; it also heightens their linguistic, logical and literary awareness, making them better students of modern languages, English, Maths and History.
Students begin Latin in Year 6. They learn why we still study Latin, its applications in the modern world and its influence on many European languages. They also establish a firm grounding in grammatical terminology, vocabulary, derivation, etymology and syntax. One-hour homework tasks are assigned weekly on vocabulary, grammar terminology, translation and mythology, and an exam based on a Common Entrance or scholarship paper is written each term. The main text used in all year groups is ISEB Latin Practice Exercises, which provides the grammatical rigour required for the Common Entrance and Scholarship levels. Additional resources such as online games and interactive learning tools form an important part of lessons for all year groups.
The Classical Greek Language Course is available to Year 6, 7 and 8 learners as a club. Its primary purpose is to cover the Common Entrance Syllabus of Classical Greek Level 1, Level 2 and/or scholarship level, including:
At the end of each academic year, the boys who attend these lessons sit for either the Common Entrance Level 1 Classical Greek exam paper or their scholarship Classical Greek exam. This course is highly recommended for Scholarship candidates and anyone passionate about Classics.
The numerous extracurricular opportunities for drama at Wetherby include a variety of performance-related projects, optional LAMDA (London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art) exams, poetry recitals and a weekly drama club. Years 3 and 4 have the opportunity to perform in the Lower School Nativity in December, gaining confidence on the stage and bringing the whole school community together at Christmas.
Students also learn to use drama techniques within lessons, from role-play to script writing and improvisation. Stage management and prop design also form part of the whole Drama experience, which culminates in Upper School in a pupil-led performance at the end of the spring term.
The study of English at Wetherby aims to foster a love of reading, writing and performing literature, and the ability to listen, speak, read and write for various purposes, using language to learn and communicate ideas, views and feelings. We encourage the students to talk clearly and confidently, and teach them how to listen and respond to others with courtesy.
As learners develop into critical and enthusiastic readers of stories, poetry, drama, nonfiction and media texts, we empower them to express themselves creatively and imaginatively through language. The benefits of a wide-ranging vocabulary (e.g., facilitating effective communication and enriching self-expression) are also promoted.
Children’s understanding of how language works is improved via the examination of its patterns, structures and origins. We aim to equip all pupils with a solid, coherent knowledge of syntax, grammar and punctuation using relevant and meaningful methods and resources.
Each year group explores a variety of genres and texts with a strong emphasis on in-depth classroom discussion, critical analysis and considered evaluation. As children are natural inquisitors, we aim to teach learners the ability to approach texts with an enquiring mind and analyse the purpose, layout and language of texts of all genres. We take an inclusive approach to textual study by exploring authors from other cultures, revealing the unheard voices of literature, disrupting masculinity in ‘Romeo and Juliet’, examining identity in ‘The Picture of Dorian Gray’, and highlighting the passion in Maya Angelou’s poetry.
Students are encouraged to use their knowledge, skills and understanding in speaking, reading and writing across a range of different situations. Achieving these objectives will ensure boys acquire the skills necessary to pass both the 11+ ISEB pre-test and the Common Entrance exams and establish a solid foundation for GCSE and A Level.
A distributive approach to literacy is promoted within the department, allowing learners to forget and therefore recall learning points, crystallising their understanding. Cross-curricular lessons are planned to dovetail themes between subjects. Learners enjoy ample opportunity to celebrate English in more practical terms with theatre trips, author talks, poetry recitals, drama workshops and competitions.
At Wetherby Prep, all students learn French. Years 3-5 focus on the spoken aspect of the language and reinforcing vocabulary, along with some basic grammar.
Upper School students receive two hours of French per week. Lessons in Years 6-8 are directly aimed at preparing them gradually for the Common Entrance examination. The French exam is divided into 4 parts: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking. Over the course of Year 8, each boy has the opportunity to practise individually for the Speaking section of the Common Entrance exam. This takes place on rotation during the registration period.
The French Department is comprised of five fluent French-speaking teachers, three of whom are native speakers. Activities range from French theatre workshops and Language Days, which promote language learning and teach students about the cultural aspect of learning a new language, to French breakfasts and a residential trip to Normandy in Year 6. In addition to these, we organise a French-themed day, in which many of our French-speaking parents participate and help to lead various workshops.
Homework is differentiated by ability level and includes written and learning components. Learners are regularly tested during the term and in normal examinations. Students have access to Linguascope, an interactive website supporting vocabulary learning.
Geography at Wetherby Prep prepares pupils to understand and deal with the world. It gets them to think creatively about combining variables, understand place and places, and think critically about both what is happening and the processes behind it. In addition to geographical facts and processes, pupils will learn measuring techniques, graphing and presentation conventions and ways of conducting good research, and draw compelling conclusions from collected and analysed spatial (GIS) and temporal data.
The Geography curriculum covers the Common Entrance and Scholarship programmes for entry into secondary schools. Common Entrance topics include: Population and Settlement; Industry and Transport; Tectonics (Earthquakes and Volcanoes); Geomorphology (Earth Processes and Landforms); Weather and Climate; Fieldwork Expedition; and Expedition Enquiry Write-Up.
Pupils also cover ordnance survey map reading and locational knowledge from across the world. Understanding the environmental impact of all geographical phenomena forms an important part of the course content.
Once boys commence the Common Entrance Programme, parents should acquire a copy of Geography for Common Entrance Revision Guide by Belinda Froud Yannic, from Hodder/ISB.
At the end of Year 7, learners are taken on a week-long expedition to complete fieldwork and commence their Expedition Enquiry coursework, which accounts for 20% of the Common Entrance examination result. Expedition attendance is therefore mandatory.
History at Wetherby Prep is brought to life using a wide variety of teaching techniques: traditional historical enquiry; role-play; visits to places of historical interest; and vigorous discussion. Whilst English (and later British) History is at the core of our curriculum, our culture is placed within a European and global context through the study of wider, related themes (e.g., the Reformation or the ascendancy of European empires).
Preparation for the Common Entrance exam starts in Year 7 with the study of ‘The Making of the United Kingdom’, the Common Entrance topic. Significant emphasis is placed on the skills needed to excel in the Common Entrance exam, including extended analysis of source material, the production of sustained and written pieces and independent judgement of the topics studied.
Wetherby boys leave our school as able and confident historians, prepared to address with confidence the challenges of History at GCS

Scholarships & Bursaries
We are committed to making our outstanding education accessible to talented pupils from a wider range of backgrounds.
Scholarships are available to exceptional applicants joining us, while bursaries provide financial support to families whose means could not grant them access to our school provision.
To be a Wetherby scholar is a major achievement and a source of pride for staff and parents alike. We grant scholarships across Academic, Sport and Drama, Art, Music and Computing.
Our school awards scholarships to recognise unique abilities or achievements in these fields, for applicants in our key admissions entry points in Year 3, Year 4 and Year 7. For more information on the criteria for each scholarship, please see our Scholarships and Bursaries brochure here: Scholarships and Bursaries brochure
We expect and support our scholars to take full advantage of the opportunities available at Wetherby Prep, which can lay the foundations for success at the very best global universities and in their future careers.
Applications for scholarships are open to all but can only be achieved by those who meet the entry requirements.
For more information about our scholarships, please enquire with our Admissions team.
Inspired Scholarship Programme
The Inspired Scholarship Programme has been created to make a premium education more accessible to families who believe in the power of learning to open up lives. Offering discounted tuition scholarships, the programme supports prospective students who aspire to make the most of an Inspired education.
The Nsouli Scholars Programme is an exciting global initiative that promises to transform lives by enabling 50 extraordinary students at any one time to attend any of Inspired’s prestigious schools on a full scholarship for the duration of their education. The ambition is that the scholarship will provide hundreds of children with an opportunity to receive a truly transformative education.
This generous endowment honours Nadim Nsouli, who founded Inspired in 2013 as a definitive statement of excellence in private international education. In recognition of Mr Nsouli’s Lebanese heritage and Inspired’s commitment to inclusivity, a percentage of the scholarships will be awarded to individuals of Lebanese origin.
Bursaries
By welcoming students from different backgrounds, we create spaces that are inclusive and engaging in all manner of potential learning opportunities.
As such, we are eager to support extraordinary learners who, from a means perspective, are unable to access our outstanding education.
Bursaries are administered via the Wetherby Bursary Fund, operated by the Gold Standard Charitable Trust (GSCT), which raises money for all Inspired UK schools. The Head will put candidates forward to the GSCT, which will conduct a means test as part of the application process. Awards for successful applicants range between 50% and 110% of the tuition fees.
To apply for bursaries, please enquire with our Admissions teams.
For details of bursaries to our school, please click the button to submit an enquiry.

Careers
Join Wetherby Preparatory School, where tradition meets innovation in the heart of London. Teach in vibrant Marylebone with full access to the exclusive Wetherby Sports Ground and a wealth of cultural opportunities. Be part of a school that combines rigorous academics, a diverse extracurricular program, and a rich cultural mix of families and staff. With unmatched opportunities for professional growth, you can advance your career both within Wetherby Prep and the wider Inspired school group.
Learn More about Wetherby Prep School
Part of Inspired Education
At Inspired Education, we offer an exceptional opportunity to join the world’s leading premium school group and shape the future of education.
Purpose & Growth Journey Join a global community with an unwavering commitment tot empowers over 90,000 students across 26 countries. As the fastest-growing education group, your contributions will directly impact our journey of continuous global expansion and excellence.
Career Development We believe in nurturing talent and offering endless possibilities for career advancement. With Inspired, you will have access to opportunities across our 118 schools, enabling you to pursue your ambitions on a global scale. 31% of our educators take on exciting new roles overseas, and over 26% of our head appointments are made from within.
Global Community & Collaboration You will become part of a diverse, inclusive team of more than 12,000 professionals from over 109 nationalities. Together, we cultivate a culture of respect, dignity, and inclusion, where your talents and experiences are valued and celebrated.
Leaders in EdTech & Innovation We are transforming education through advanced technology and cutting-edge innovation. We invest more than any other school group in AI, EdTech, and immersive learning, enabling our educators to personalise learning paths and improve student outcomes.
State-of-the-Art Facilities Our campuses are designed to reflect our progressive approach to education. You will work in an environment that encourages exploration, creativity, and student engagement. With access to the latest tools and technologies, you will have the resources to inspire and motivate students, helping them to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.
A Culture of Innovation & Growth We foster a growth mindset that extends beyond our students to our entire community. Together, we are shaping a future where education is dynamic, inclusive, and always evolving.
Learn More about Inspired Careers

Our red doors are opening wider
Open Day | Wednesday 17th March 2027
A new co-ed era of excellence
Join us for our Open Day and discover a nurturing, ambitious co-educational experience shaped for the future.
Designed for prospective parents, this event offers the opportunity to step inside Wetherby Prep, hear from our expert team, explore our state-of-the-art facilities, and see how academic excellence, tailored support, and a seamless Wetherby journey come together.
Discover Wetherby Prep
Admission to top UK senior schools
Learn how Wetherby Prep pupils are prepared for successful progression to prestigious senior schools, with many securing places and merit-based scholarships at leading destinations.
A meticulously planned, ambitious curriculum
Discover how our ambitious curriculum balances academic rigour with holistic development, outstanding tailored support, and strong preparation for future academic success.
Extensive and premium extracurriculars
Explore exceptional opportunities across sport, the arts, and many other exciting disciplines, helping every pupil discover their interests and develop their unique potential.
A path to success beyond prep school
See how a values-based Wetherby education, shaped by expert guidance and exceptional opportunities, helps pupils build confidence, character, and ambition for the future.
What to expect
Welcome from our Headmaster: Begin the morning with an introduction to Wetherby Prep School and the values, ambition, and vision shaping this exciting next chapter.
Meet our leadership team: Hear from our Senior Leadership Team and ask questions about academic life, pastoral care, co-curricular opportunities, and the wider school experience.
Pupil-led school tours: Explore our school and facilities, and hear from the pupils on the exceptional environment that supports excellence in the classroom and across the extra-curricular programme.
Admissions guidance: Speak with our Admissions Team about entry points, timelines, and the next steps in your family’s Wetherby journey.
Who better to demonstrate the day-to-day life of our school than the pupils themselves? Hear from their first-hand experiences, ask questions and talk about the impressive range of opportunities which await your children at Wetherby Prep. They look forward to sharing their passion for the school with you.
School address: 48 Bryanston Square, London W1H 2EA
Best suited for: Late Sept 2027 applicants and those applying for Sept 2028 places
This event is best suited to parents only as it is held during the school day. Children are invited to separate events once registered.
If you need them, full details are:
Guests arrive at 9.30am. Depart at 11.00am
We are opening the doors of Wetherby Prep to prospective families and inviting you to join us to learn more about our exciting and innovative education, and how we inspire and motivate our pupils to achieve excellence in the classroom and across the extra-curricular programme.
Discover what makes our school so special; take a look round our state-of-the-art facilities and talk to our pupils about why they love coming to school each day.
Secure your place today
Join us at our Spring Term Open Morning on Wednesday 17th March, 2027 to discover a school where proud tradition, academic ambition, expert guidance, exceptional facilities, and future-focused learning come together.
If no Open Day places are available below, or none suit your schedule, we would be delighted to welcome you for a Personalised Tour at a time that works for you.

Co-curricular Activities
Exciting Opportunities for Holistic Development
We firmly believe that a strong holistic education is vital to developing boys’ unique potential and equipping them with tools for success beyond prep school. Our generous co-curricular programme prepares pupils to become confident and well-rounded individuals by developing their skills outside the classroom.
Wetherby Prep boasts an extensive and established sports programme in which pupils can refine their athletic abilities and enjoy much-needed physical exercise regularly. Students are strongly encouraged to pursue their unique interests and explore new areas with our broad, exciting club offering, which ranges from dodgeball and Krav Maga to ceramics, chess, coding and photography. Enriching school trips add depth to the syllabus by boosting engagement and fostering key life skills, while School Council promotes active involvement in the development of the broader school community.
Sports
Our exceptional sports programme helps boys to develop their athletic abilities to a high level, earn various esteemed accolades, and cultivate important life skills and personal qualities.
Through challenging and engaging sports sessions, our experienced coaches and specialist teachers empower students to become skilled sportspeople, whether in football, rugby, cricket, swimming, golf tennis or water polo. Our young athletes achieve top honours in local and national sporting competitions, including the Independent Schools Golf Association (ISGA) tournament and the Independent Association of Prep Schools (IAPS) Skiing Championships, and compete regularly with leading London and Surrey prep schools. With twice-yearly sports tours to exciting destinations, such as Holland and South Africa, our boys have the valuable experience of competing at a global level.
By providing a positive experience of physical activity, we equip students with vital, transferable competencies such as resilience, adaptability, cooperation and mental agility, and establish the foundations for lifelong wellbeing. Our approach to sports is inclusive and based on Wetherby’s core values: no matter his skill or ability level, each boy is encouraged to get involved and discover and nurture his unique interests.
Our co-curricular sports offering includes:
Football Rugby Cricket Swimming Water Polo Tennis
Clubs
Our extensive club programme allows pupils to realise their full potential by exploring, discovering and cultivating their unique skills and interests. Students become adept across various disciplines and develop into confident, resilient, independent and well-rounded individuals.
Supported throughout by our talented, dedicated club leaders, pupils are challenged to become skilled competitors: the Fencing, Chess and Swimming club boys regularly excel in local and national tournaments. With that said, we applaud boys’ enthusiasm and willingness to try new things. As such, students of all abilities are encouraged to participate in our morning and afternoon club sessions.
With over 70 clubs to choose from, pupils enjoy plenty of exciting opportunities to hone their specific talents and explore new areas, including:
Cricket Football Swimming Tennis Fencing Horse Riding Rock Climbing Badminton Dodgeball Krav Maga Skateboarding Choir String Ensemble Rock Band Ceramics Photography Drama Chess Coding
School Trips
Throughout their prep years, boys enjoy regular school trips meticulously planned to enhance syllabus engagement and promote positive values.
From Year 3 onwards, students participate in trips, including an annual residential trip lasting three to five days. These trips are themed to focus on core curriculum elements or foster good citizenship.
In previous years, trips have included visits to PGL Marchants Hill and PGL Liddington for team-building adventures, a three-night surfing trip to Cornwall, and a week in the Lake District for multi-activity experiences. Students have also completed Geography fieldwork projects in Cumbria and celebrated their final prep year with a week-long trip to Shropshire.
Our school trips continue in the holiday period when students embark on exhilarating activities such as skiing, a Classics trip to Italy, and a Battlefields trip to France and Belgium.
School Council
Our boys are active stakeholders in school life, as evidenced by our passionate School Council. This lively and enjoyable forum allows students to meet weekly and discuss, debate and act upon issues of importance to the school body, while also fostering a sense of community and valuable communication skills. The matters discussed at School Council meetings include everything from adding new options to the school’s club programme to distributing packed lunches and selecting a theme for the Headmaster’s fancy dress.
The School Council is an essential avenue for communication and collaboration throughout Wetherby Prep. The Head of School Council chairs meetings and Miss Lister takes minutes, which are then distributed to the staff and Headmaster via email for discussion, comment and response. The minutes also appear in our weekly school newsletter, Wetherbuzz.
Each form elects a representative at the beginning of the school year. The persuasiveness and fervour of the election manifestos, and the fact that votes are at times very close, show how dedicated our boys are when it comes to representing their peers on School Council.
Learn more about our broad and exciting co-curricular offering and how it helps nurture confident, resilient and multi-skilled pupils.

Parent Community
Parent Teacher Association
As a prep school we recognise and value the role of parents in our children's academic development. For this reason, we foster a vibrant parent community that seeks to actively enrich all areas of school life.
All parents and teaching staff are members of the Wetherby Prep School Parent Teacher Association. Our PTA meets twice a term with the Head and organises social and practical events throughout the school year. Activities championed by our dedicated PTA members range from raising money for our charities to fostering a sense of community among staff and parents. The school calendar is packed with events organised by our active PTA, including a summer fete, quiz night, candlelit dinner, mums’ night out, dads’ night out and a biennial summer ball.
Discover more about our excellent PTA and how parents contribute to our thriving school community.

A World-Class Preparatory in Marylebone, Central London
Wetherby Prep School
Wetherby Prep Becomes Co-Educational
Now welcoming girls and boys
Wetherby Prep’s transition to co-education marks a thoughtful evolution in our story, one that enriches learning, strengthens pathways, and provides even more opportunities for every child.
Learn more Register Your Interest
Setting the Standard for Exceptional Prep Education in London
Welcome to Wetherby Prep, a prestigious and well-established private boys’ preparatory in Marylebone, Central London. As one of London’s top prep schools, Wetherby Prep has developed an unparalleled record of exceptional academic provision and inspiring opportunities that successfully prepare boys for a lifetime of accomplishment.
At our leading prep school in London, we prepare pupils to excel in their 11+ and 13+ Common Entrance examinations. Best-in-class academic provision and bespoke, holistic preparation mean that boys secure coveted places at some of the best senior schools in London, often on merit-based scholarships.
A Holistic, Innovative Prep Programme in London
Our curriculum is carefully crafted to develop all aspects of our boys’ potential, in the classroom, onstage and on the sports field. Through an extensive, expert-led extracurricular programme, pupils develop their unique talents in exciting disciplines and foster the tools for success in prep school and beyond.
Wetherby Prep equips pupils with a solid educational foundation that includes top academic preparation, diverse and in-demand skills, strong values and an appreciation for positive interpersonal relationships and community.
Why Choose Our Prep School in Marylebone, London?
Our leading preparatory in London, ranked ‘excellent’ by the Independent Schools Inspectorate, offers a challenging, nurturing environment in which each and every pupil sets high standards and gains valuable skills to achieve his greatest ambitions.
Our curriculum is carefully crafted to deliver leading preparation for the Common Entrance exams and Scholarships, with outstanding results. After graduating from Wetherby Prep, pupil attend some of the most prestigious senior schools in the UK, including Eton, Harrow and Winchester College.
Extensive extracurriculars allow boys to develop their unique passions, explore new disciplines, and become confident, independent, multi-skilled pupils. Experts in sports and arts prepare boys for exceptional achievements, whether in national sporting events or performances at top London venues.
A Meticulously Planned, Ambitious Curriculum
Balancing academic rigour and holistic development with outstanding, tailored support and preparation for the 11+ and 13+ Common Entrance exams.
Admission to Top UK Senior Schools
Our graduates secure entry into prestigious senior schools, including Eton College and St Paul's, with many gaining merit-based scholarships.
Extensive & Premium Extracurriculars
Maximising boys’ unique potential in sports, the arts and many other exciting disciplines.
A Path to Success Beyond Prep School
A values-based prep education for boys in an ideal setting, fostering their unique talents with exceptional opportunities.
Reception
Lower School
Upper School
Outstanding results in the 11+ and 13+ Common Entrance exams and top senior school destinations point to our prowess at providing the best possible outcomes for our boys. Graduates of Wetherby Prep secured places at some of the UK’s best day and boarding schools over the past 5 years, including:
Wetherby Prep is part of Inspired Education, a group of 121 prestigious private schools worldwide. As an Inspired school, we strive to maximise our students’ potential with an outstanding prep education and unique, enriching opportunities, from leading tutelage and academic preparation to exciting extracurricular activities which foster exceptional sporting and artistic abilities. The Group’s unparalleled offering is based on a commitment to excellence that spans Academics, Sport and the Performing and Creative Arts. As a result, graduates of Inspired schools are academically accomplished, confident, independent and multi-skilled individuals.
Part of a Global Group of Top Independent Schools
Part of a Global Group of Top Independent Schools
With 85,000+ students across 6 continents, Inspired schools set the standard for exemplary private education globally. Each school is carefully crafted to promote top outcomes using innovative methods and a shared holistic approach, yet also remains anchored in its local context and community. This provides pupils with a solid educational foundation for their future and allows graduates to flourish at the highest levels, no matter where in the world they end up.
Hand-Picked Teachers
Hand-Picked Teachers
Teachers at Inspired schools are hand-selected for their outstanding credentials and experience. Their genuine passion is reflected in their lessons, in which innovative methods meet global best practices to produce stimulating and inspiring interventions, including in highly respected international curricula. With impeccable prep tutelage, our pupils score highly on assessments and enjoy a seamless transition into the next stage of their education.
Guaranteed Entry to Premium Boarding Schools
Guaranteed Entry to Premium Boarding Schools
Upon graduating from our independent prep school, pupils may choose to expand their horizons by enrolling in any of Inspired’s boarding schools globally. Inspired students gain automatic entry into exceptional private secondary schools across Spain, Kenya, the United Kingdom and elsewhere, where they continue to enjoy excellent opportunities in academics, sports, the arts, and other areas.
Exchange Programmes & Global Camps
Exchange Programmes & Global Camps
As part of a global community of Inspired schools, our pupils access a range of exciting travel opportunities. Student exchange programmes and global summer camps offer valuable experience by allowing the pupils to immerse themselves in other cultures. As a result, our boys gain skills and qualities that allow them to flourish well beyond the prep school level while developing lifelong friendships and connections.
Discover how our preparatory for boys in London can help maximise your son's potential in class and out and establish a path to unlimited future opportunities.

Admissions Process
Begin Your Child's Journey to Unlimited Future Opportunities
Application
Thank you for choosing our excellent school. Our main entry points are in Reception, Years 3, 4 and 7, though we do accept GIRLS AND BOYS in other year groups when occasional places become available. Kindly complete our registration form below to apply for a place and begin the admissions process.
Boys currently at Wetherby School have priority to places at Wetherby Preparatory School in Year 4. Parents need to complete a transfer form at any point up to the end of Year 2 and the boys will then have an assessment during the Autumn Term in Year 3, with places offered in the normal way.
Wetherby Transfer Form
Applications are open for 7/8+ for AY 27. Limited places available. The application deadline for the 2027 /28 academic year is Wednesday 30th September 2026
We are happy to consider late applications and applications for occasional places. We will always seek to accommodate children who would thrive in our school, if sufficient places are available.
Our community is typically fully enrolled; however, on occasion, places become available due to relocation or changing family circumstances.
We invite you to contact our Head of Admissions, Clare Beckwith, to discuss current occasional place availability on 020 7535 3522 or please reach out by clicking on the 'Enquire Now' button below and submitting a query.
Assessment
Entry to Reception is non selective.
Candidates entering Years 3 and above complete an assessment using a standardised testing platform, providing an age-appropriate understanding of their Maths and English ability, and participate in interactive workshops with our staff. Tests take place in October.
Test for any late applications are taken between November 26 and and March 27.
Assessment for AY 2027/28 will take place for all candidates on Friday 16th October 2026.
Receive an Offer
The outcomes of assessments and workshops will determine which candidates receive places. Formal offers will be sent to candidates who have secured a definite place.
An exclusive offer holder event will be held in late January 2027 for parents of successful applicants with an offer of a place, enabling parents to meet our Senior Leadership Team and ask any outstanding questions about life at Wetherby Prep.
Admission
Should our offer be accepted, we will request an Acceptance Deposit. Your child then enrols in Wetherby Prep School.
For further information about the admissions process, please click the button below to submit an enquiry. Our friendly team will be happy to assist you with your application.

Fees
The Best Investment for Your Child's Future
Selecting the right prep school for your child is one of the most important choices you can make. Wetherby Prep offers exceptional, holistic prep education in which boys are supported and challenged to set high standards and unlock their full potential. An ambitious, tailored curriculum led by talented teachers prepares students to excel in the Common Entrance exams and gain coveted places at leading UK senior schools. Each pupil cultivates his specific interests with our extensive extracurricular programme, including unique opportunities in sports, the arts and other exciting areas.
For a list of our 2026-27 fees, please see below. Our fees are reviewed annually, and we will notify parents and guardians of any increase at the end of the Spring Term.
2026-27 Fees
We are pleased to share that for the 2026-27 academic year, our fees are as follows:
£180 (one off fee paid when registering your child)
£4,700 (One off amount paid when confirming a place)
Tuition, lunches, textbooks: £11,540 per term
Tuition, lunches, textbooks and Common Entrance exam fees: £11,650 per term
School Bus For your convenience, parents can make bookings via the Student Safe parent app for the entire academic year at a charge of £2,850 (£950 per term)
All instruments: £400 per term
School Activities & Clubs
These are charged individually, the costs being advised at the time of enrolment.
For further information regarding our school fees, please submit your enquiry using the form below. A member of our team will get back to you shortly.

Our red doors are opening wider
Preparing Pupils for Today and Tomorrow
Wetherby Prep is entering a new chapter, introducing co-education as part of our commitment to providing an exceptional education for every child. It will also become Wetherby Pembridge Prep, strengthening progression and expanding opportunity across our 2–18 Wetherby Pembridge pathway.
From the earliest years, boys and girls will learn together in an inclusive environment that encourages confidence, collaboration, and adaptability. This approach ensures pupils are not only academically prepared but also socially equipped to thrive in an interconnected world.
For families who prefer a single-sex pathway, Wetherby School Notting Hill and Wetherby Senior School (boys) or Pembridge Hall (girls) remain established options, maintaining flexibility across the wider Wetherby group.
A seamless Wetherby Journey
Begin at Wetherby Pembridge Minors (Ages 2-4), for a personalised, nurturing and aspirational start to school life.
Pre-Prep to Prep (Ages 4-13)
Move on to Wetherby School (Kensington, Notting Hill or Marylebone), where early foundations are established, and academic depth is built to prepare for senior school entry.
At 11+ or 13+, pupils move into senior education, with two distinct pathways:
Wetherby Senior School – a traditional boys’ senior education
Wetherby Pembridge Senior School – a co-educational, forward-looking senior school experience
This pathway builds on the long-standing strength of Wetherby School, creating a clear and connected route from early years through to senior education. As part of Inspired Education, pupils benefit from both a strong academic foundation and a broader, global perspective.
Academic Rigour with Broader Perspective
Pupils at Wetherby Prep are challenged to think critically, communicate clearly, and take ownership of their learning. Co-education adds a new dimension. Different perspectives strengthen discussion, sharpen reasoning, and encourage confident participation. Outside the classroom, a strong co-curricular programme develops leadership, independence, and personal growth, ensuring pupils are ready for the next stage.
Join Us on This Exciting Journey
Wetherby Prep’s transition to co-education marks a thoughtful evolution in our story, one that enriches learning, strengthens pathways, and provides even more opportunities for every child.
Applications for girls to join Reception and Year 3 are now open.
Register Your Interest
Receive updates, key dates, and admissions guidance as we introduce co-education.
Arrange a visit to experience our environment and meet the team shaping your child’s journey.
Register Your Interest
FAQs
Why is the school becoming co-educational?
Wetherby Pembridge Preparatory School will welcome boys and girls to broaden access and choice, while developing collaboration, adaptability, and confidence from the earliest years, without changing the standards families trust.
Will single-sex pathways remain?
Yes. We recognise the importance of choice for families, established single-sex options will remain, alongside the co-educational pathway. Wetherby School Notting Hill for boys - with an all-boy pathway to Wetherby Senior School and Pembridge Hall School for girls.
How will this affect current pupils?
There will be no change to teaching, pastoral care, or curriculum. The transition will be managed to ensure continuity and balance.
What support is in place during the transition?
Clear structure, strong pastoral care, and carefully managed cohorts will ensure every child feels supported.
How does co-education benefit my child academically and socially?
It supports collaboration, independence, and adaptability, preparing children for life.
Will the ethos or values of the school change?
No. The school’s core values and standards remain firmly in place delivering the Wetherby experience our parents and pupils know and love.
How does this impact admissions and progression through Wetherby?
The pathway from early years through to senior school remains aligned, with clear progression and consistent expectations from Preparatory onwards.

School Destinations
Aspire to Greatness: Access the Senior School of Your Dreams
Our students are consistently supported and challenged to set high standards, including after they have left prep school. In addition to accessing outstanding tuition, which helps them gain top exam results, our boys enjoy tailored advice to assist them in choosing the best senior school for their needs. They go on to attend some of the most prestigious senior schools that, crucially, are perfectly suited to their talents, interests and personalities.
Leaver Destinations 2009-2026
A Pathway to Excellence at Top UK Day and Boarding Schools
Most pupils leave us after Year 8 (at age 13+) when they transfer to some of the UK’s leading senior schools. With that said, we also have an excellent track record of students entering top London day schools after Year 6 (at age 11+). Around half of our students move to boarding schools while the other half join day schools every year. Below are the main boarding and day-school destinations for our boys:

Enquire Now
Start Your Child's Journey to Unlimited Opportunities
Wetherby Prep offers best-in-class prep education for boys (and girls from September 2027), establishing a path to success at the highest levels. Passionate teachers with leading credentials guide pupils through a tailored and inspirational curriculum, with rigorous preparation for the Common Entrance exams resulting in entry to elite UK senior schools. An extensive extracurricular programme allows students to discover and nurture their unique talents in exciting disciplines, building confidence, resilience and in-demand competencies. Our pupils ultimately graduate with outstanding academic results, and the qualities and skills necessary for a lifetime of accomplishment.
To get in touch with our school’s admissions team, please call 020 7535 3522 or complete our Enquiry Form here:

Our Campus
The Perfect Environment for Unlocking Pupils' Full Potential
Pupils at our school enjoy leading facilities, both on- and off-site, with exceptional and modern resources to support excellence in all areas and providing the ideal backdrop for exemplary prep education.
Our excellent location in Central London offers a range of exciting cultural opportunities to enrich school life and easy and direct access to the city via Marble Arch and Edgware Road tube stations, a short walk away.
Magnificent Learning Facilities for a World-Class Holistic Education
Premium On-Site Facilities
Our spacious classrooms are meticulously crafted to optimise learning and contribute to outstanding outcomes. Cutting-edge learning technologies, including iPads and Surface Go devices, enhance lessons by boosting engagement and enabling further study. Science lessons are brought to life in three fully-equipped laboratories, and budding artists can hone their craft in our well-resourced art room. Our advanced ICT facility is specifically designed to deliver excellent computer-based tutelage on our 22 state-of-the-art desktop machines.
Students with a flair for performance cultivate their skills in our versatile Performing Arts Suite, which hosts music recitals, plays, advanced drama and in music pods for instrumental lessons.
Weekly assemblies take place in the Pioneer Hall and a local church, fostering community and a sense of pride in our school identity. Our well-supplied library is a retreat for boys wishing to extend their studies in a relaxed, comfortable setting. Experienced, thoughtful caterers prepare meals in our excellent kitchen daily to help students stay healthy and well-nourished.
View Campus Location
Reception Facilities
Our brand-new Reception facilities have been thoughtfully designed to create the perfect environment for these vital early years of learning. Fresh, modern, and tailored in the typical style favoured by Inspired Education, the spaces are warm, welcoming, and perfectly suited to boys aged 4+, offering everything they need to learn, explore, and thrive. From purpose-built classrooms to engaging play areas, every detail supports curiosity, creativity, and confidence, laying the strongest possible foundations for lifelong learning.
Outstanding Off-Site Facilities
We have forged close connections with prestigious local organisations to give students unique opportunities to refine their sporting and artistic skills at world-class off-site facilities.
Drama and music productions take place at established venues around London, including the award-winning Marylebone theatre, providing the valuable opportunity to perform in a professional space.
The school enjoys exclusive access to extensive sports facilities in Acton, including professional-standard all-weather pitches hosting multiple sports and community events all year round. Our students nurture their sporting abilities and physical fitness at Inspired Sports Grounds, a secure, state-of-the-art sports facility equipped with an astroturf, clubhouse and numerous pitches, and Lord's Cricket Ground. In Hyde Park, students practise horse riding in a quiet and spacious environment.
Learn how your child can benefit from an outstanding holistic education at our school, where we will challenge and support them on their path to unlimited accomplishments.
